verdict.rationale: The skills are packaged as SKILL.md folders and installed through the open, vendor-neutral `skills` CLI (`npx skills add`). They target multiple agents (Claude Code, Codex, Pi), with portable Agent Plugins metadata alongside Cursor metadata, so the same skill folders work beyond one vendor's tooling. missing for 10: an explicit statement of conformance to the Agent Skills specification, spec-level validation (validate.mjs checks only the repo's own contracts and version parity), and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-tool portability.
